about_the_game:
SCAVENGER ZERO is an action roguelike and political simulator set in the midst of a galactic-scale war. You play as a mercenary with the codename "Viper", doing jobs for powerful factions with varying ideologies and beliefs as to what's best for the universe.

The missions you undertake, the relationships you build, and your choices will determine the fate of the star system.

BECOME A MERCENARY

Deploy onto a variety of procedurally generated planets to complete missions for clients. Explore everything from rainy highlands to deserts to isolated rocks at the very edge of the stars.

ACCESSIBLE MECH BUILDING

Create your own mech using hundreds of unique parts. Mech building is simple and doesn't require analyzing spreadsheets of information and stats. Any build is viable, and there are literally millions of possible combinations.

A CONFLICT OF GALACTIC SCALE

Days pass with each mission you complete. Over time, the limited number of pilots in the star system will dynamically fight each other based on their alignments, relationships, and more. The war will end, and time will progress with or without you.

Do you step in and try to bring peace to the warring factions? Do you stay neutral and let it play out? Or do you bide your time, wait, and strike when the enemy is weak?

A BLEND OF LO-FI AND HEAVY METAL.

The soundtrack mixes together different genres of music. There is calm, lo-fi music during down time, which ramps up and explodes into heavy metal during combat.

FIND THE TRUTH, SAVE THE WORLD.

Each faction has their own agenda, their own views on the world and how it should be run. Depending on who you side with, a variety of different endings can be achieved.

... Or, you can take the world for yourself, and burn it all to the ground.

content_descriptors.notes: SCAVENGER ZERO depicts characters using drugs and alcohol. Some characters talk about criminal acts in a positive light, and heavy language is used. Themes of depression and suicide are mentioned; but never explicitly shown.
